title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr

claims.claim: Granola launched a dictation feature today.

evidence.quote: Granola, known for its meeting notetaker, launched a dictation feature today.

claims.claim: Wispr launched a meeting notetaker months after launching its dictation tool.

evidence.quote: This comes months after Wispr, known for its dictation tool, launched a meeting notetaker.

claims.claim: Granola's dictation currently works on Mac.

evidence.quote: Granola’s dictation currently works on Mac just like any other such tool.

claims.claim: Granola stated that the dictation feature will land on iOS and Windows soon.

evidence.quote: The company said that the feature will land on iOS and Windows soon.

claims.claim: Granola is valued at 1.5 billion dollars.

evidence.quote: Granola and Wispr are valued at $1.5 billion and $2 billion, respectively.

claims.claim: Wispr is valued at 2 billion dollars.

evidence.quote: Granola and Wispr are valued at $1.5 billion and $2 billion, respectively.

claims.claim: Fireflies, Speechify, and Monologue have converged into multi-feature apps with meeting note-taking and dictation capabilities.

evidence.quote: Other voice startups such as Fireflies, Speechify, and Monologue have converged into multi-feature apps with meeting note-taking and dictation capabilities.
